description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing expenses, including CRUD operations and filtering, using Flask with Flask-Smorest and webargs for request validation.

classes.name: ExpenseFilterSchema
classes.description: Schema for filtering expenses with optional start date, end date, and category ID.

classes.name: ExpenseListResource
classes.description: Handles HTTP GET for listing expenses with filters and POST for creating new expenses.

classes.name: ExpenseResource
classes.description: Handles HTTP GET, PUT, and DELETE for a specific expense identified by ID.

methods.name: get(self, expense_id: int)
methods.description: Lists expenses applying optional filters present in query parameters.

methods.name: post(self, amount, expense_date, category_id=None, description=None)
methods.description: Creates a new expense entry in the database.

methods.name: get(self, start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None, category_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific expense by ID.

methods.name: put(self, expense_id: int, **updates)
methods.description: Updates an existing expense, only for the provided fields.
